_comment: sheets: PMD walk sheets (8 direction rows x N frame columns), keyed by the SHAPE name the game uses -- the folder on disk may be spelled differently. sprites: single-image overrides, optionally a {src,x,y,w,h} crop out of a packed sheet. images: whole sheets kept as canvases for the ground tilesets and backdrops. sfx: short one-shot sounds. attacks: forms whose Attack-Anim.png is loaded as a drawable sheet for the one-shot cast animation; the folder comes from the sheets entry of the same name.
